snippet.title: Driftwood 1.0 Trailer
snippet.description:
After two years in Early Access, Driftwood launches into its full release version!

What's new in 1.0?
- Play with up to 8 friends in the new p2p Online Multiplayer!
- Enjoy a completely overhauled progression system + new hub world
- Explore 15+ total levels
- Complete many new challenges
- Enjoy new outfits & gear

Get it on Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/2223700/Driftwood/

Song: Marscott - French Press
